description:
Operational defaults for heartbeat cadence, lock timeout/polling, temporary-file cleanup, and claim TTL are source-defined but lack one maintained complete projection.

Source: `crates/jit/src/agent_config.rs:43-65`; `crates/jit/src/storage/json.rs:107-123`; `crates/jit/src/storage/lock.rs:118-155`; `crates/jit/src/commands/claim.rs:830-848`; `crates/jit/src/cli.rs:2551-2572`; `docs/reference/configuration.md:261-280`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: One source-derived surface presents the default heartbeat interval, lock timeout/polling, temporary-file cleanup threshold, and claim TTL with units and operational scope.
- [hard] REQ-02: Existing coordination documentation consumes or is mechanically checked against that surface.
- [hard] REQ-03: Conformance coverage fails when a listed default changes without projection refresh.
title: Project runtime coordination and recovery defaults
